title: Daily RSI(2) oversold dip buy in 200-day uptrend, exit above 5-day SMA
rule_summary: Signals from closed DAILY candles built from the 1h data, executed at the next 1h open. RSI(2) uses Wilder smoothing on daily closes. ENTRY: daily close > SMA(200 days) of daily close AND RSI(2) < 10 AND no open position. EXIT: first daily close above SMA(5 days) of daily close, OR daily close below SMA(200 days). No profit target, no pyramiding. Optional protective stop (not part of the published exit): none in the base rule; a developer may add a fixed percentage stop below entry. Free numbers: RSI length 2, threshold 10, exit average 5, trend average 200.
mechanism: Very short-term sell-offs inside an established uptrend are often forced or impatient selling (liquidations, panic sellers) that overshoots; liquidity takers pay a concession to dip buyers, and price snaps back toward its short mean. The source gives only a brief rationale (extreme readings flag dips; the 200-day filter avoids downtrends); the liquidity-overshoot story is the closest honest mechanism.
